description: A chess game box sits on the table in front of a red curtain, and when it’s opened there are plastic bags of pieces and a flat board insert inside. The left hand and right hand come in to make the chess box a two-hand object, lift the lid up and off, then the left hand picks up one bag of pieces and sets it into the lid tray while the right hand lifts the other bag out and places it with the first; after that, both hands reach into the bottom half to lift and remove the flat board insert.
